content: EXLA has precompiled XLA CPU binaries for aarch64-linux-gnu (confirmed via GitHub release xla v0.10.0 asset xla_extension-0.10.0-aarch64-linux-gnu-cpu.tar.gz). No source compilation (XLA_BUILD=true, Bazel/Clang) needed on ARM64 Linux for CPU-only inference. Binaries target glibc (gnu), so the Docker runtime image must be glibc-based (Debian), not Alpine/musl. Bumblebee text_embedding serving must set EXLA.Backend explicitly (Nx.default_backend) - without it, ops run in pure Elixir and a single embedding can take over a minute vs sub-second with EXLA configured.
